QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] Speak with the Sword
QuestInfo.0: Continue the conversation with the man who appears to be the leader of the thieves.
QuestInfo.1: The man who appears to be the thieves' leader says talk is meaningless at this point, telling you to prove yourself with the sword if you want to play hero. Cut down the Phantom Trees in the area to prove your strength.
QuestInfo.2: You proved your strength to the man who seems to be the leader of the thieves.

mob.0: It's pretty straightforward work. You guys saw those creepy trees on the way here, right? Of course you did; the forest's full of 'em. What we want you to do is give them a little 'trim'. What do you say?
